seed: Object names may encode position or identity. Work out the naming rule from the data and derive renaming on move, birth and removal from it, so names are never looked up.

synth.notes:
Tiles: a click inside an editable tile's bbox switches color_14 <-> color_15.
Operators: a click switches the operator's own marker_14/15 and the tiles 8 cells away up, down, left and right. Glyph neighbours stay unchanged.
Glyphs and empty cells: clicks do nothing. Actions 1-5 and 7 are no-ops (never observed).
Names are '<tile|glyph>_<y>_<x>'. Operators use the glyph prefix. Names are rebuilt from position and are static because nothing moves.
Unconfirmed: clicking a glyph or empty cell and actions 1-5 and 7 are assumed to do nothing. No hidden state; the program is stateless.
